title: Add permanent regression evidence for the known audit finding corpus
description:
Attach durable regression evidence to each enumerated known audit finding/disposition.
Evidence tests the generalized violated invariant over the bounded affected population
that can actually be established. Where exhaustive membership cannot be independently
established, use permanent adversarial/representative evidence plus explicit scope limits
instead of inventing a true population.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every enumerated known finding has a durable current disposition, owner, violated invariant, and regression evidence or explicit unresolved blocker.
- Regression evidence detects recurrence of the generalized defect class within its justified scope.
- Unsupported source claims have negative provenance regressions.
- Intentional adjudication/ambiguity cases have positive boundary regressions.
- No finding requires a fabricated exhaustive membership query; unknown/unbounded scope is recorded as such, never treated as zero.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
CANONICAL ALIAS PREFIXES — never a bare "F1" or "CAP-001":
  engine:F1 .. engine:F10     pack executionReadiness engineHooks[].engine families
  fable:F1 .. fable:F8        Fable 5 audit findings
  opus:F-01 .. opus:F-35      Opus 5 original + amended audit findings
  sol:CAP-001 .. sol:CAP-014  GPT-5.6-Sol agent audit findings
  indep:001 .. indep:012      independent review (formerly "SOL-001..012"; renamed
                              so it stops colliding with the sol: model-name prefix)
